units.rawText: Nanaka's song echoes through the sky above Burbank.

units.rawText: Below the music-filled sky, Reverence faces off with Kuro.
units.displayText: Below the music-filled sky, Reverence faces off with Kuro.

spans.text: Below the music-filled sky, Reverence faces off with Kuro.

units.rawText: In order to battle the evil Sanctifiers, the cute moe moe Nanaka transforms into a strong, beautiful warrior and makes a triumphant return with a brand new image!
units.displayText: In order to battle the evil Sanctifiers, the cute moe moe Nanaka transforms into a strong, beautiful warrior and makes a triumphant return with a brand new image!

spans.text: In order to battle the evil Sanctifiers, the cute moe moe Nanaka transforms into a strong, beautiful warrior and makes a triumphant return with a brand new image!

units.rawText: That marketing slogan is making its rounds through the sector.
units.displayText: That marketing slogan is making its rounds through the sector.

spans.text: That marketing slogan is making its rounds through the sector.

units.rawText: Really now? That won't change the fact that you're about to be cleansed.
units.displayText: Really now? That won't change the fact that you're about to be cleansed.

spans.text: Really now? That won't change the fact that you're about to be cleansed.

units.rawText: I'm not opposed to a proper, fair and square duel with you.
units.displayText: I'm not opposed to a proper, fair and square duel with you.

spans.text: I'm not opposed to a proper, fair and square duel with you.

units.rawText: You're a Sanctifier; you have principles of your own. You can't be going around using [BLEEP] methods like us Irregular Agents now, can you?
units.displayText: You're a Sanctifier; you have principles of your own. You can't be going around using [BLEEP] methods like us Irregular Agents now, can you?

spans.text: You're a Sanctifier; you have principles of your own. You can't be going around using [BLEEP] methods like us Irregular Agents now, can you?

units.rawText: [Uncivilized language detected...]
units.displayText: [Uncivilized language detected...]

spans.text: [Uncivilized language detected...]

units.rawText: Why do you have to censor every little thing I say!?
units.displayText: Why do you have to censor every little thing I say!?

spans.text: Why do you have to censor every little thing I say!?

units.rawText: An Irregular's words are pointless gibberish. Now, would you mind dying already?
units.displayText: An Irregular's words are pointless gibberish. Now, would you mind dying already?

spans.text: An Irregular's words are pointless gibberish. Now, would you mind dying already?

units.rawText: Tsk, how come SHE doesn't get censored...
units.displayText: Tsk, how come SHE doesn't get censored...

spans.text: Tsk, how come SHE doesn't get censored...

units.rawText: Anyway, listen up! I know a fight is inevitable, but if we do battle the way we did, we're going to wreck the sector, right?
units.displayText: Anyway, listen up! I know a fight is inevitable, but if we do battle the way we did, we're going to wreck the sector, right?

spans.text: Anyway, listen up! I know a fight is inevitable, but if we do battle the way we did, we're going to wreck the sector, right?

units.rawText: We might end up having to shut the sector down again after it came back online after so much effort!
units.displayText: We might end up having to shut the sector down again after it came back online after so much effort!

spans.text: We might end up having to shut the sector down again after it came back online after so much effort!

units.rawText: So?
units.displayText: So?

spans.text: So?

units.rawText: When in Rome, do as the Romans do—our upcoming battle will be decided by hits, by which I mean traffic.
units.displayText: When in Rome, do as the Romans do—our upcoming battle will be decided by hits, by which I mean traffic.

spans.text: When in Rome, do as the Romans do—our upcoming battle will be decided by hits, by which I mean traffic.

units.rawText: Lame. Why would I bother when one quick whack with an axe would settle everything?
units.displayText: Lame. Why would I bother when one quick whack with an axe would settle everything?

spans.text: Lame. Why would I bother when one quick whack with an axe would settle everything?

units.rawText: Reverence takes a step forward, and Kuro immediately turns the camera drone to face her.
units.displayText: Reverence takes a step forward, and Kuro immediately turns the camera drone to face her.

spans.text: Reverence takes a step forward, and Kuro immediately turns the camera drone to face her.

units.rawText: What's this? So your vaunted strength doesn't even match up to an Irregular's?
units.displayText: What's this? So your vaunted strength doesn't even match up to an Irregular's?

spans.text: What's this? So your vaunted strength doesn't even match up to an Irregular's?

units.rawText: Are you going to disgrace the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Are you going to disgrace the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Are you going to disgrace the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Reverence tightens her grip on her weapon, then glares at the camera lens in seething silence.
units.displayText: Reverence tightens her grip on her weapon, then glares at the camera lens in seething silence.

spans.text: Reverence tightens her grip on her weapon, then glares at the camera lens in seething silence.

units.rawText: Right, these are the rules... First, we'll compete to see who gets Nanaka trending higher.
units.displayText: Right, these are the rules... First, we'll compete to see who gets Nanaka trending higher.

spans.text: Right, these are the rules... First, we'll compete to see who gets Nanaka trending higher.

units.rawText: Whoever gives Nanaka more hits wins the first round. I'll even tell you the trick to it; constantly create sockpuppets to stir up discussion about her. Surely this won't be too hard for an Intermediate Sanctifier, no?
units.displayText: Whoever gives Nanaka more hits wins the first round. I'll even tell you the trick to it; constantly create sockpuppets to stir up discussion about her. Surely this won't be too hard for an Intermediate Sanctifier, no?

spans.text: Whoever gives Nanaka more hits wins the first round. I'll even tell you the trick to it; constantly create sockpuppets to stir up discussion about her. Surely this won't be too hard for an Intermediate Sanctifier, no?

units.rawText: ...Don't look down on me.
units.displayText: ...Don't look down on me.

spans.text: ...Don't look down on me.

units.rawText: The second round is to get Kuro trending, then comes the final round. Win any two and you win it all. How's that? Pretty fair, right?
units.displayText: The second round is to get Kuro trending, then comes the final round. Win any two and you win it all. How's that? Pretty fair, right?

spans.text: The second round is to get Kuro trending, then comes the final round. Win any two and you win it all. How's that? Pretty fair, right?

units.rawText: It sounds a little fishy to me, but I don't think I'll lose to an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: It sounds a little fishy to me, but I don't think I'll lose to an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: It sounds a little fishy to me, but I don't think I'll lose to an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Come on. I'll make sure the video of you getting smashed to bits makes it to No. 1.
units.displayText: Come on. I'll make sure the video of you getting smashed to bits makes it to No. 1.

spans.text: Come on. I'll make sure the video of you getting smashed to bits makes it to No. 1.

units.rawText: Like I said, how come she gets to escape the censors...
units.displayText: Like I said, how come she gets to escape the censors...

spans.text: Like I said, how come she gets to escape the censors...

units.rawText: Ahem, bring it on! I won't lose when it comes to a trending battle!
units.displayText: Ahem, bring it on! I won't lose when it comes to a trending battle!

spans.text: Ahem, bring it on! I won't lose when it comes to a trending battle!
